catalog.name: France
catalog.summary: Premium developer intelligence for French identifiers, SIREN/SIRET, TVA, RIB/IBAN, NIR boundaries, postal formats, payments, locale conventions, privacy-safe fixtures, and offline validation workflows.

hub.name: France
hub.description: Developer intelligence for French company, tax, banking, address, identity-boundary, payment, vehicle, privacy, and localization workflows with browser-only validation where possible.

sections.title: Identifier stack
sections.description: France combines SIREN company identifiers, SIRET establishment identifiers, TVA tax identifiers, INSEE commune codes, and privacy-sensitive NIR values.

cards.name: SIREN
cards.description: Nine-digit company identifier with local Luhn check evidence.

cards.name: SIRET
cards.description: Fourteen-digit establishment identifier: SIREN plus NIC.

cards.name: TVA intracommunautaire
cards.description: FR plus a two-character key and SIREN; local key derivation can be checked before VIES.

cards.name: NIR
cards.description: Sensitive personal identifier; ValidoHub provides syntax/key and masking helpers, not identity proof.

sections.title: Banking and payment stack
sections.description: French banking data is built around RIB fields, IBAN conversion, BIC routing, and SEPA remittance conventions.

cards.name: French IBAN
cards.description: 27-character IBAN beginning with FR, with embedded RIB structure.

cards.name: RIB
cards.description: Bank code, branch code, 11-character account number, and two-digit RIB key.

cards.name: SEPA
cards.description: Transfer, direct debit mandate, RUM, and remittance helpers for French payments.

cards.name: Reconciliation
cards.description: Local parsers for amounts, dates, references, masked IBANs, and duplicate-risk notes.

sections.title: Localization and data quality
sections.description: French forms need careful treatment of accents, comma decimals, DD/MM/YYYY dates, CEDEX addresses, phone ranges, and privacy-safe logs.

cards.name: Address and postal
cards.description: Postal code, department, commune, region, CEDEX, and address normalization tools.

cards.name: Phone numbers
cards.description: National 0X spacing, +33 E.164 conversion, range classification, and masking.

cards.name: EUR formatting
cards.description: Comma decimals, space thousands, API-safe numeric parsing, and display formatting.

cards.name: Privacy boundary
cards.description: GDPR, PII masking, NIR masking, vehicle redaction, and fixture generation.
